entries.zh: 埋伏、暗中守候（西语 hacer embocada 当即「设伏」）
entries.en: to lie in wait, to set an ambush (Sp. hacer embocada, prob. = hacer emboscada)
entries.notes: afechar 在此组六条均相当于 acechar；embocada 疑为 emboscada 之讹，H 當（tǹg，守候）可相印证。

entries.zh: 窥伺、守候（如盗贼、猎人潜伏等候目标）
entries.en: to lurk, to lie in wait (as a thief or a hunter does)
entries.notes: L 栏 uel 即 vel「或」，举盗贼、猎人为例；H「照料」仅部分相合，M gyo 对应汉字未定。

entries.en: to look secretly, to peek stealthily

entries.zh: 向人使眼色并上下打量（从头看到脚）
entries.en: to wink at someone and size him up from head to foot
entries.notes: L 栏句末被截断（mirandole lasi da-）；「上下打量」据 H 脚頭手尾（kha-thâu-tshiú-bué，从头到脚）推得。

entries.en: to go and look stealthily and slowly
entries.notes: H「蛮」有[疑]标，当为「慢」（bān，缓慢），方与 despacio 相合。

entries.en: to steal a sideways glance, to look askance
to reassure, to comfort; to make secure

entries.zh: 宽慰人心、解除心中不安
entries.en: to set someone's heart at ease, to relieve his anxiety
to soothe, to quiet, to console
entries.notes: H「慰服」非常语，R 栏 cō 与「服」不对应，释义据西语 quietar/consolar 定。

entries.en: to settle something in place, to arrange it securely
ancestors, forebears
ancestors of former generations
ancient forebears (MS reads 祖地, 'ancestral ground')
entries.notes: H「祖地」与西语 progenitores antiguos 义不合，疑原稿用字有误。

entries.en: ancestors, the stock and root of the family

entries.zh: 祖辈老人、历代先祖（abuelos y abos）
entries.en: grandfathers and forefathers
to sit down
to hang up, to set something in place
entries.notes: H 挂（kuà）本义为悬挂，与 asentar「安放」义仅部分相合。

entries.en: to turn (one's head) around, to turn over
entries.notes: H 挂轉頭 即 kuà-tńg-thâu「转头」，与 bolverlo y rebolverlo 相合；首字「挂」于义无取。

entries.en: to prop something up from underneath
entries.notes: H「亏」与 M「guēng／gīong」无法确解，仅据西语「下垫支撑」义定。

entries.zh: 安放稳当、使之安适（H 号乞伊自在＝予其自在）
entries.en: to settle something so that it rests easy; to put something underneath
entries.notes: M 与 R 两栏音写全同，疑栏位错置；释义据 H「号乞伊自在」（hō͘ khit i tsū-tsāi）与西语义。

entries.en: to saw
